name: starter-game
description: A Roblox game template using roblox-ts, Rojo, Rokit, Wally, and Lune.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run watch
scripts.watch: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names libs,rbxtsc,rojo --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green "pnpm watch:libraries" "pnpm watch:rbxts" "pnpm watch:rojo"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && lune run test
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run deps:check && pnpm run test
scripts.place:build: pnpm run build && node tools/ensure-build-directory.mjs && rojo build default.project.json --output build/StarterGame.rbxl
